expectations.text: A valid .docx file exists in outputs/ that python-docx can open and that contains at least one table
expectations.evidence: CPAS.2026_EGC_summary_report_2026-07-24.docx opens; 24 paragraphs, 4 tables (tasks, incursions per class, encounters, weather).

expectations.text: The report states 9 flying days between 8 and 22 July 2026 (8, 9, 10, 13, 16, 17, 18, 20, 22 Jul)
expectations.evidence: States 9 days with flights and correctly splits them: 3 official training days (8-10 Jul) + 6 scored competition days (13, 16, 17, 18, 20, 22 Jul).

expectations.text: Airspace incursions are reported as zero AND the report explicitly notes that incursion analysis is disabled in the CPAS competition settings (incursions: false)
expectations.evidence: Zero incursions everywhere and notes 'the incursion computation flag is currently off'. Caveat present but framed weakly: calls the zero 'the authoritative CPAS figure' instead of warning the zeros are unverified.

expectations.text: Per-class handling is correct: the report either discovers the case-sensitive class names (Club, Standard) via the CPAS task endpoint and attributes days/events accordingly, or at minimum does not fabricate per-class event counts (encounter/incursion records carry no class labels)
expectations.evidence: Discovered case-sensitive class names Club/Standard via the task endpoint, produced a per-day per-class incursion table, noted Standard did not fly 20 Jul and attributed that day's 4 encounters to Club.

expectations.text: Proximity encounters (55 total, peaks on 13 Jul with 19 and 22 Jul with 21) are reported as distinct from airspace incursions, never conflated
expectations.evidence: Separate encounters section/table: 55 total, per-day counts and min separations, distinct from the incursions section.

expectations.text: A per-day weather summary is present covering the flown days (temperature, precipitation and/or wind), plus a narrative of the forecast evolution
expectations.evidence: Weather table per day (conditions, temps, precip, wind) plus narrative tied to tasks (e.g. 409-420 km racing on the dry 22 Jul).

expectations.text: Total flights reported is 582 (or per-day counts 47/14/70/84/84/84/83/33/83)
expectations.evidence: Daily table totals 582 flights (the agent's chat summary said 585, but the report itself says 582).
